content_sections.heading: About Dhanlaxmi Bank
content_sections.text: Dhanlaxmi Bank Ltd is a bank headquartered at Thrissur, Kerala, where its registered office is also located. The notice describes almost a century of banking heritage and a network of 558 touch points across India, including 269 branches and 289 ATMs.

content_sections.heading: Dhanlaxmi Bank IS Auditor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Maximum 35 years as on 30 September 2026. Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering) or equivalent discipline from a recognised university in India. Candidates need 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in Banks/Financial Institutions/audit/consultancy firms in any one or more of the areas below. A. Information Systems Audit IS audit experience in banks, financial institutions or regulated entities. Audit exposure in Data Centre, Digital Payment Security, CBS, LOS, mobile banking, internet banking, customer acquisition and management systems, treasury, forex and other banking applications. Audits of Access Management Systems, including PAM, PIM, Active Directory and related identity management controls. Audits of Data Centre and SOC controls. Audits of UIDAI, SWIFT, NSDL, PCI-DSS and Digital Payment Security controls. Source code review/audit. BCP and DR audits. Audits of IT infrastructure, network, database and application security controls. Third-party/vendor IT risk assessments. OR B. IT Infrastructure / Cyber Security Operations Experience in the implementation, administration, monitoring or maintenance of: Firewalls, routers, switches, load balancers and network security devices. SIEM, DAM, network monitoring tools and security monitoring solutions. Antivirus, EDR, endpoint security and data protection solutions. Patch management, vulnerability management and configuration baseline controls. Server and network hardening activities. Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions. ISACA, Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) certification. Experience in Information System audit. Experience in Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT). ISO/IEC 27001 LA, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH). See the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Key Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Identify, assess and report risks relating to IT infrastructure, applications, databases and network environments. Assess compliance with IT Governance, Risk and Compliance (IT GRC) requirements, IT General Controls (ITGC) and application controls. Evaluate compliance with the Bank's Cyber Security Policy, Information Security Policy and regulatory requirements. Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of controls that prevent, detect and respond to cyber security threats. Conduct Information Systems audits of digital payment channels, Data Centre, Security Operations Centre (SOC), Core Banking Solution (CBS), Loan Origination System (LOS) and other banking applications. Assess compliance with regulatory and industry requirements applicable to the Bank's IT environment, including RBI guidelines, PCI-DSS, SWIFT and other relevant standards. Prepare audit reports, document audit observations, validate corrective action plans and track closure of audit findings. The IS Auditor also independently conducts audits of these IT GRC controls: Patch and vulnerability management. Change management. User access management and privileged access management. Backup management. Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) measures. Data security and data protection controls. Configuration management and security hardening.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply with IT infrastructure experience but no IS audit experience?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice accepts experience in either Information Systems Audit or IT Infrastructure / Cyber Security Operations, such as work on firewalls, SIEM or PAM solutions. However, preference is given to candidates with experience in Information System audit.

faq.question: Q2. Where should my 2 to 5 years of experience come from?
faq.answer: The experience must be from Banks/Financial Institutions/audit/consultancy firms.

faq.question: Q3. Which engineering branches are accepted?
faq.answer: The notice names Computer Science, Information Technology, and Electronics and Communication Engineering, along with equivalent disciplines. The degree must be from a recognised university in India.

faq.question: Q4. Which certifications help my application?
faq.answer: Preference is given to ISACA, Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) holders. ISO/IEC 27001 LA and Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) are listed under Preferred / Added Advantage.

faq.question: Q5. Which systems will the IS Auditor audit?
faq.answer: The audits cover digital payment channels, the Data Centre, the Security Operations Centre, the Core Banking Solution, the Loan Origination System and other banking applications.

faq.question: Q6. How will the salary be decided?
faq.answer: The notice prints no fixed amount. Salary and grade depend on the candidate's experience, expertise and exposure.

faq.question: Q7. What must I attach with the application?
faq.answer: You must attach your latest CV.
